_comment: THE ONE committed vector table for the `go` directive predicate. Read by BOTH substrate's tests/directive-test.nix (Nix) and gen's directive_vectors.rs (Rust). A single byte edit here MUST turn both suites red; if only one goes red, a second copy of the rule exists somewhere and that is the defect. Every verdict arm carries >= 1 row -- tests/directive-test.nix asserts that, because an arm with no vector is a branch nothing exercises.
